gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Noto Sans Tamil has terminals that stop well away from the stem, so the text looks magnified without growing. Expose, by contrast, is all tight, striking compression, with caps barely rising above the lowercase.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-tamil-supplem: Tight, striking Expose headings sit hard against a body with a tall middle band and round, parenthesis-like forms. Noto Sans Tamil Supplement then loosens everything up, and the sans feels stocky next to such a compressed top line.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Approachable is the first word that fits Noto Sans Tangsa, whose round letters open wide and whose ascender stems stay short. Expose earns its keep big and brief, where its compressed, refined cut can make a striking statement.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-tc: Noto Sans TC gives the pair its open-handed side, with large counters in a, e and s and curves that flare outward. Expose compresses above it, striking and tight.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-telugu: A barely-there step from lowercase to caps gives Expose its compressed, refined punch, with hardly a pause between letters. Noto Sans Telugu handles the quieter work, its high midline and connected counters keeping the sans text open to the outside.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-thaana: Noto Sans Thaana reads wide and welcoming, with big lowercase forms and generous channels running into each counter. Noto Sans Thaana keeps that openness going down a full page, while Expose stays up top, compressed and striking.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-thai: Noto Sans Thai has lowercase forms swollen like inflated glass beads. Over a full page, Noto Sans Thai keeps those rounded letters open and approachable, a plain sans counterweight to the tightly compressed Expose headline above.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-thai-looped: Tall, bold-looking lowercase gives this pairing its weight. Noto Sans Thai Looped leaves spacious gaps at its curve terminals, while Expose earns its keep big and short, compressed and striking.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Puffed-up bowls meet a squeezed, striking headline here, since Noto Sans Tifinagh fills its line like inflated shapes while Expose runs tight. Rounded and open below, compressed above, the two give the page a clear top and bottom.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Noto Sans Tirhuta cuts its terminals back to leave a big gap, and its x-height dominates the line. Expose, striking and compressed, takes the opposite stance, and the two settle into a lively tension on the page.
